item.title: CBI raids CM Bhagwant Mann’s camp office, his OSD’s home in graft probe
item.description: CBI conducted raids on multiple locations including the camp office of Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann. The investigation stems from a High Court order based on allegations from the Enforcement Directorate. Various individuals are named in the FIR for their alleged involvement in corruption and manipulation of government processes. Mann criticized the timing of the raids as politically motivated amid upcoming elections.
item.dc:creator: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA AND VIBHOR MOHAN

item.title: Flydubai cockpit attack left Capt Smit Machchhar with 'depressed skull fracture'
item.description: Captain Smit Machchhar faced serious injuries from his co-pilot during the flight's crisis situation. The co-pilot attacked him with an axe, resulting in a skull fracture that required emergency surgery. Doctors monitored his recovery closely and assisted him for further treatment in the UAE. The Indian embassy is providing support to Captain Machchhar and his family during this challenging time.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Ukrainian drone attack sets fire to oil tanker carrying 23 Indians off Russia
item.description: The Aframax Rio tanker caught fire off the Russian coast after an attack by unmanned vessels. All 23 crew members onboard, who were Indian nationals, were successfully rescued by emergency crews. The incident occurred near Sochi, leading to the closure of beaches in the area. Authorities monitored air and water quality, assuring safety for public health.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: 'Against all odds': Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike awake after failed execution
item.description: Christa Pike, a death row inmate in Tennessee, is recovering at a hospital following a failed execution attempt. Her lawyers reported that she is awake and speaking after being unconscious for several days. Doctors say the extent of her recovery remains uncertain, and she might face a long rehabilitation process. Legal questions arise about whether Tennessee can execute her again after the failed lethal injection.
item.dc:creator: YASHASVI VASISTHA

item.title: SpaceX overpumped 128M gallons of groundwater; now Texas city has to pay $175,000
item.description: McGregor has agreed to pay $175,000 in penalties for groundwater overuse linked to SpaceX's activities. The city will make a one-time payment and subsequent quarterly payments over 25 years. Residents have expressed concerns over the arrangement, as SpaceX primarily drove the overpumping issue. City officials are exploring alternative water sources to address future needs. Groundwater conservation efforts will focus on monitoring and reusing available water resources.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Opposition's anti-SIR-CEC march turns into INDIA bloc-government face-off
item.description: Opposition members from the INDIA bloc, led by Rahul Gandhi, organized a protest march to the Election Commission. The police stopped their march just before reaching Akashvani Bhavan, leading to a lengthy dharna by the MPs. Despite police attempts to remove the protesters, several MPs entered the Akashvani premises and continued their demonstration. Rahul Gandhi criticized Prime Minister Modi and accused his government of treasonous actions against the country.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Man deposits Rs 85.3 lakh given to him as cash gifts, gets notice; ITAT gives relief
item.description: In one such case in Chennai, a man received cash gifts of Rs 85.03 lakh from his relatives. The Income Tax Department began making enquiries into the source of the Rs 85.03 lakh deposited by the man. The department also sent tax notices to the relatives who had given him the cash. The man eventually won relief in ITAT Chennai.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Gujarat: Married woman, lover forced into public sex as ‘punishment’
item.description: A shocking incident occurred in Surendranagar where a couple was subjected to horrific punishment by the woman's husband. After the couple was located, police arrested nine individuals involved in the brutal acts. The couple was reportedly filmed during the ordeal, which was shared on social media. Authorities were alerted by local community leaders who facilitated the police intervention.
item.dc:creator: NIMESH KHAKHARIYA

item.title: Most GST refunds may be processed within 17 days
item.description: The GST Council intends to shorten the refund processing period to around 17 days for businesses. It will also work to automate registering for a GST number to speed up the process. For small businesses operating in multiple states, avoiding repetitive registrations will be considered. Additionally, the proposal includes eliminating physical verification for registration cancellations. Changes will allow input tax credit on various business-related expenses to facilitate smoother operations.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: 'North by Northwest' star Eva Marie Saint passes away at 102
item.description: Eva Marie Saint, the acclaimed actress famed for her iconic role in ‘On the Waterfront’, has sadly passed away at her Los Angeles residence, surrounded by her loving family. Born on July 4, 1924, in Newark, New Jersey, she was raised in Albany and Delmar, New York. Throughout her illustrious career, Saint captivated audiences with her performances in numerous films and television series, earning a multitude of prestigious awards.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: 40M-year-old glass sponge reefs found alive off B.C. after thought extinct
item.description: In 1987, Canadian scientists discovered ancient glass sponge reefs alive in British Columbia’s Hecate Strait, overturning the belief that these reef-building animals had vanished 40 million years ago. More than 9,000 years old, the reefs survive today in Hecate Strait, Queen Charlotte Sound and Howe Sound, creating a rare underwater ecosystem often called the “Sea of Glass.”
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: 13 Navy personnel under scanner in Pakistan-linked espionage probe
item.description: A significant counter-intelligence operation named 'Operation Firewall-2026' is underway across multiple states in India. Eighteen individuals are being investigated for their suspected connections to an espionage network linked to Pakistan. Among the suspects, 13 are reported Navy personnel, and electronic devices have been seized during searches. Two individuals have already been arrested for allegedly leaking sensitive information related to the Indian Navy.
item.dc:creator: VENU LANKA

item.title: 80% vote in West Bengal bypolls amid rigging, intimidation charges
item.description: Bypolls across Nandigram and Rejinagar saw an 80% turnout despite allegations of rigging and voter intimidation. In Tamil Nadu, turnout dipped compared to previous elections, with results showing 86% and 80% participation. Assam's Nagaon Lok Sabha constituency recorded 76% turnout during the bypolls, while Puducherry's Thattanchavady seat had a turnout of 78% by 5pm. Various candidates and parties reported incidents of interference and blocked agents during the polling process.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: From Gujarat CM to India's PM: Modi's 25 years in office
item.description: Narendra Modi's journey began with his role as Gujarat Chief Minister, addressing state issues and implementing reforms. His tenure included launching significant initiatives like the Jan Dhan Yojana and Swachh Bharat Mission, aimed at improving welfare. The BJP's political maneuvers led to Modi becoming Prime Minister in 2014, marking a significant shift in governance.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation: Why are his parents stepping in?
item.description: Travis Kelce’s 87 & Running Foundation has not posted since January 2026. They continue their charitable work through Operation Breakthrough’s Ignition Lab. Donna Kelce met with Ignition Lab students during a Kansas City Chiefs game. Ed Kelce visited first graders at Operation Breakthrough. Travis Kelce’s foundation got its first post after January on Travis’ birthday.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Travis and Jason Kelce’s $10,000 donation: How did it help Laila Edwards’ family?
item.description: Earlier this year, Travis and Jason Kelce quietly donated $10,000 to help a Team USA hockey star’s family travel to Milan for the 2026 Winter Olympics. The contribution supported a $50,000 fundraiser created after the family struggled to afford the trip. Travis also offered encouragement before the Olympic debut, while Jason and Kylie attended the gold-medal game. Team USA eventually defeated Canada 2-1 in overtime for gold.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Meet Monarchs: ‘Endangered’ traveller butterflies that survive on poisonous milkweed
item.description: The extraordinary migration of monarch butterflies stretches across thousands of miles, connecting North America and Mexico. Sadly, their population has sharply declined, prompting the International Union for Conservation of Nature to mark them as endangered. Key threats include habitat loss, pesticide usage, and climate change, which disproportionately impact their crucial milkweed supply. To aid these delicate creatures, conservation efforts are imperative, with U.S. federal protection still pending.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Rajnath launches first desi fleet support ship ‘Surya’ at Visakhapatnam
item.description: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched ‘Surya’, India’s first indigenously-built fleet support ship in Visakhapatnam. He also laid the keel for the fifth ship in the series and inaugurated upgraded infrastructure at Hindustan Shipyard Limited. These developments aim to enhance the Indian Navy’s operational capabilities and self-reliance in naval shipbuilding. Additionally, Rajnath announced the establishment of a second production line for Shakti engines in Koraput.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: Punjab govt moves SC against CBI probe into ‘bribe syndicate’ linked to Mann OSD
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's government has approached the Supreme Court for an urgent hearing. They aim to challenge a High Court order that mandated a CBI investigation into corruption allegations. The High Court's concerns include alleged coercive actions by the Central Bureau of Investigation in the state. The Punjab government argues that the orders violate governance principles outlined in the Constitution.
item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: Michael Douglas recalls affairs with co-stars; being 'caught in bed'
item.description: Michael Douglas has recently published a memoir that shares intriguing details about his past relationships. He recounts an affair with Jeanne Tripplehorn during the filming of 'Basic Instinct'. The actor also reflects on being caught by his wife in a compromising situation, which led to an ultimatum. Douglas chose rehabilitation over divorce after the incident with his wife, Diandra Luker.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: Congress itself, not EC, responsible for its losses: BJP
item.description: BJP has dismissed the march demanding the removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar as a sign of opposition frustration. During the protests, BJP representatives criticized Rahul Gandhi and questioned the credibility of his claims about member attendance. Union ministers expressed that the Election Commission is not responsible for Congress's electoral failures. BJP spokespersons emphasized the party's continued success and the opposition’s inability to connect with voters.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: ED unearths bribe racket involving top executives of 40 PSUs, banks & companies
item.description: Enforcement Directorate has uncovered a bribery racket involving executives from at least 40 public sector undertakings and banks. This scheme involved laundering corporate social responsibility funds through multiple trusts operated by a fake doctor. The fake doctor has been impersonating a medical professional for nearly three decades while receiving substantial donations. Investigations revealed kickbacks were paid, with funds returned to donors after deducting commissions.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Amid Canada trade talks, NSAs discuss security coop
item.description: India and Canada are engaged in a security dialogue to strengthen their bilateral relations. NSA Ajit Doval hosted his Canadian counterpart David Morrison for discussions on security issues. Both nations reviewed their progress in law enforcement cooperation and identified areas for further collaboration. Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand is also scheduled to visit India later this month.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Election Commission: Was ready to meet 240 oppn MPs but not at their chosen venue
item.description: Election Commission declined a meeting with opposition MPs led by Rahul Gandhi at Parliament House annexe. The commission emphasized meetings should occur on its premises and through authorized representatives. Despite being offered a chance to submit a memorandum, the MPs rejected this proposal. The Commission stated it had not received prior appointment requests from the parties until late in the day.
item.dc:creator: BHARTI JAIN

item.title: Two sisters turned their childhood love of the ocean into a 65-foot research yacht
item.description: Angela Rosenberg and her sister took a significant step by establishing the ANGARI Foundation to fill the void in marine science education. Collaborating with Florida International University, they facilitate student participation in real-world expeditions aboard the research vessel R/V ANGARI. These experiences, including shark tagging and plankton exploration, aim to ignite students' passion for marine science, fostering a connection between youth and the ocean.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: Cabinet adopts resolution hailing achievements of PM Modi
item.description: Cabinet has adopted a resolution recognizing Narendra Modi's 25 years of public service as Chief Minister and Prime Minister. This resolution highlights various policies that benefited the common man, showcasing Modi's governance style. It mentions key initiatives like SWAGAT and PRAGATI that improved governance and service delivery. Additionally, it discusses welfare schemes that helped millions escape poverty and empowered women in society.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Astronomers find ‘phoenix planet’ born from ashes of a dying star
item.description: A team of astronomers has discovered a second-generation planet orbiting a white dwarf named HS 0209+0832. This planet formed from the material that the white dwarf expelled during its death. The atmosphere of the white dwarf contains heavy elements such as zinc, copper, and niobium. This discovery could change the way astronomers search for similar planets around dead stars.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: British Indian peer Lord Ranger wins right to judicial review of CBE annulment
item.description: Lord Rami Ranger has successfully challenged the decision to revoke his CBE by King Charles. The revocation was based on allegations of breaching the parliamentary code of conduct. Justice Nathalie Lieven ruled that the decision could be subject to judicial review due to its significant personal consequences. Lord Ranger's legal team argues that due process was not followed in the decision-making process.
item.dc:creator: NAOMI CANTON

item.title: Jammu and Kashmir: Arms & drugs seized in cross-border smuggling case; 4 held
item.description: J&K Police arrested four suspects linked to cross-border drug and arms smuggling. The police seized a Beretta pistol, magazines, live rounds, and narcotics during this operation. Initial arrests occurred when two men were stopped at a checkpoint and found with heroin and a firearm. This investigation revealed connections with handlers based in Pakistan and previous air-dropped consignments. The case has been registered under relevant laws with further investigation ongoing.
item.dc:creator: SANJAY KHAJURIA

item.title: 'I am already sleepy': Jet-lagged Shreyas Iyer's candid reply after maiden T20I ton
item.description: Shreyas Iyer basked in the glory of his Asian Games gold medal before stepping up to lead India in the T20I series against West Indies. His outstanding innings of 102 not out off just 43 balls propelled India to victory. Iyer acknowledged the challenges of travel but showcased his adaptability. Meanwhile, debutant Naman Dhir shone with three wickets, cementing a solid bowling effort.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: Pakistan successfully test-fires extended version of Fatah-4 cruise missile
item.description: Pakistan successfully conducted a test of its extended-version Fatah-4 cruise missile, which can hit long-range targets. The missile was able to validate various technical parameters, enhancing its precision and survivability. High-ranking military officials and government leaders were present to witness the launch and praised the effort. The Fatah-4 missile, operating at low altitudes, aims to evade detection from air defenses.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Garba’s new luxury flex: Valet, VVIP seats and butlers
item.description: During this year's Navratri, vadodara's garba events have embraced luxury, offering participants premium packages that promise comfort and exclusivity. Attendees can enjoy benefits like valet parking, VIP seating, and personalized services to enhance their experience. Special packages are also available for non-resident Indians and out-of-state guests seeking convenience. Meanwhile, Ahmedabad is stepping up with high-priced options, indicating a broader shift toward exquisite and lavish festival celebrations.
item.dc:creator: TUSHAR TERE

item.title: Why Dybala and Molina are blocked from Messi’s farewell despite 2022 squad invite
item.description: Paulo Dybala and Nahuel Molina will miss Lionel Messi’s Argentina farewell after Roma blocked their trip to Buenos Aires. The club cited the lengthy journey and proximity of important fixtures, with manager Gian Piero Gasperini stressing the demanding schedule. Both players remain linked to Argentina’s 2022 World Cup triumph, but neither was selected for the current international window.
item.dc:creator: SOROR SHAIZA

item.title: EU ready to send observers for first Palestinian parliamentary vote in nearly 20 years
item.description: The European Union has expressed its commitment to send election observers for the upcoming Palestinian legislative elections on November 28, marking the first such elections in 17 years. This pivotal moment allows Palestinians the chance to choose their leaders following a prolonged hiatus. However, logistical hurdles, largely due to restrictions imposed by Israel in occupied regions, pose significant challenges.
item.dc:creator: PRANJAL PANDEY

item.title: Shreyas Iyer's maiden T20I century powers India to eight-wicket win over West Indies
item.description: In a thrilling opening match of the series, Shreyas Iyer reached his maiden T20I century, finishing with a stunning 102 runs off just 43 balls. This remarkable innings paved the way for India's eight-wicket triumph over West Indies. Debutant Naman Dhir made a mark too, claiming three wickets as the Windies were limited to 171 runs. India now leads the series 1-0, showcasing their prowess in both batting and bowling.
item.dc:creator: NITESH DUBEY

item.title: Anirudh Thapa goal a brief bright spot as Uruguay run riot against India
item.description: India ended their three-match home friendly window with a 1-6 defeat to Uruguay at Salt Lake Stadium on Tuesday. Anirudh Thapa's goal briefly gave the home faithfuls something to celebrate. But in a game of two halves, Uruguay found their scoring shoes with Darwin Nunez, Maxi Araujo, Rodrigo Zalazar, Juan Manuel Sanabria and Rodrigo Aguirre hitting the back of the net.
